trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Plan for roughly 200 hours: the long grind is 100% completion, 250 stunts and the shooting-range golds. There are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies, so the platinum is long rather than hard. Sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion checklist only appears afterwards, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. It holds 35 tasks — the story, 15 of the 18 collectible card sets, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges, all 8 bank vaults and more. Work on the side tasks as you play, because almost everything stays open after the credits. Sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and 397 stunts exist across Leonida. You need 250 for the trophy and 300 for 100% completion, so keep going past the pop. Stunt markers on the map make it easy to route a run through several at once. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two shooting ranges hold 42 gold-medal challenges between them. Gold rewards accuracy, not speed, so learn each range's weapon pattern and take the shots calmly. The Progress screen shows how many golds you still need. Sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and expect a 4-star Wanted Level on the way out. Five vaults earn the trophy; 100% completion needs all eight. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger mission strands count toward this one. Not every optional questline does: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies, so they do not add to this counter. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One race in the strand, Race Against Yago in Chapter 3, is time-sensitive, so run it the moment it appears. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Collectible cards come in 18 sets hidden across Leonida — in shops, homes and landmarks. Complete any 3 sets for the trophy, and keep collecting afterwards: 100% completion needs 15 sets. Work on cards during normal travel rather than leaving all 18 sets to the end. Sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan landmarks and points of interest as you travel Leonida; each new location counts. It adds up during normal play if you scan whenever you pass somewhere new. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts as discovering them for Whip It Good. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers — races, fishing, arcade games, the gym, hunting, drone races, shooting ranges, meditation and more. One try of each is enough; you do not need to win or master any of them. Sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street races, off-road events and the Top Fun drone races each have their own circuits. Races unlock as you meet their organizers through the story and stranger strands. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Escape a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you. Bank vault jobs hand you 4 stars straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this too. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the northern counties. The map fills in as you travel, and the trophy pops once no region is left unexplored. Fast travel does not count, so drive, fly and sail the gaps yourself. Sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way. Operations are marked once you scout them; bring your partner for the bigger ones. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs. Launder them by selling to your contacts; the $250,000 total is cumulative across the whole game. Keep doing vault and loan jobs and it fills up on its own. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. Drone races are short and technical — learn the gates on a practice run before racing for the win. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulative. Weapons, clothes, food and car mods all count. It fills up naturally if you buy gear as you play instead of hoarding cash. Sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal at a fishing spot and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing game: watch the line tension and reel in short bursts when the fish runs. You can retry the challenge as often as you like. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.description: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game games counts.
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four in-game arcade games. The cabinets sit in bars and arcades around Vice City. Finishing a game is enough — you do not need a high score. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida; the spots show as purple icons when you are close. Bring your partner every time: each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters. WARNING — the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is missable: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning after the mission Down to Earth, follow her to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, so keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes around the city; block one, crack it open and grab the cash, then lose the police. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress, Challenges. 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, and many complete on their own while you play. Check the list regularly and mop up the easy ones — driving, shooting and exploration challenges — between missions. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Gone Fishing early in the story. It pops when the mission ends. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a few minutes late. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Play the story missions in order; side content can wait until after the story. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now Jason and Lucia can switch freely, so most of the side list opens up — but the story trophies just need the missions done. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Bank vaults open near the end of this chapter through That's Where The Money Is, so start the vault jobs as soon as they appear. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, and you will want a clean save for post-story cleanup. Once the credits roll, the 100% checklist appears and the rest of the list stays open. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which opens most of the trophy list — partner trophies, shared activities and the rest. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back if you want to redo a story beat. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so there is no rush — finish the strand whenever you like. Kenton's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, since it has its own trophy. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for to finish the line. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Jason and Lucia both need to reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just keep playing and check Progress now and then. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and order a drink; it should come during normal play. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. A car through the showroom glass is the obvious reading. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description, 'Second time's the charm,' is the only hint. Treat it as one that comes during normal play rather than one to chase. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — 'What the hell just happened?' is the only hint. It is likely tied to a strange sight while exploring Leonida; keep an eye out and let it come. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' is the only hint: a melee attack from a moving vehicle at a bowling alley. Sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
